canonical_project: Leading Edge Data Centres Newcastle (Mayfield West)
notes: Regional Tier III edge colocation at Mayfield West, Newcastle LGA; ~75-rack edge facility; LEDC announced a $19.6m Newcastle/Hunter investment covering four 375kW facilities (1.5MW total). LEDC Newcastle, Tamworth, Dubbo and Albury reported operational per DigitalBridge-backed build-out; no large hyperscale project found in Newcastle LGA.
